quote: There is a real risk that the benefits of editing would flow disproportionately to the wealthy, widening existing health inequalities. Globally, the picture is even starker: some countries may permit heritable editing while others prohibit it, leading to cross-border reproductive travel and uneven safety standards. A just approach, many argue, would require not only strict regulation but also attention to fair access, public funding for therapies that address serious diseases, and measures to prevent discrimination against people who are unedited or who carry genetic differences.
